items.title: Could Ross Stores (ROST)’s Blowout Comp Growth Signal a Bigger Market Share Opportunity?
items.summary: Ross Stores, Inc. (NASDAQ:ROST) surged after raising its full-year fiscal 2026 earnings guidance. The off-price retailer boosted its FY26 EPS target to $8.61–$8.77 from $7.50–$7.74, cruising past consensus estimates of $7.82. The primary catalyst was a stellar Q2 2026 report. items.title: TJX Just Dropped 11% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell?
items.summary: TJX beat estimates, raised guidance, and expanded margins, yet the stock shed 11% in a month while its closest rival surged 34% year to date. The split between what the business delivered and what investors did next tells a complicated story about where the risk actually sits.

items.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Soars 37% on a $100M Tariff Refund and Raised Guidance, Ross and Kohl’s Hold Steady
items.summary: A $100 million tariff refund sent Abercrombie surging in a single session while the same catalyst left Kohl's nearly unchanged and Ross investors shrugging. The gap between those reactions reveals something more important than the windfall itself.

items.title: Jefferies cuts TJX to Hold as Marmaxx stumbles and Ross pulls ahead
items.summary: Investing.com -- On Wednesday, Jefferies downgraded TJX Companies (NYSE:TJX) to Hold from Buy with a $145 price target, arguing the slowdown at its Marmaxx division looks more serious than a routine merchandising miss.

items.title: Kohl’s Falls 6% Despite Raised Guidance and a $150M Tariff Refund, Ross and TJX Hold Flat
items.summary: Kohl's posted a blowout earnings beat and raised its full-year outlook, yet shares are cratering while rivals Ross and TJX barely flinch. The reason buried inside the margin numbers may explain why investors are refusing to celebrate.
